item.title: United Airlines has widespread system failure just days after nationwide ground stop
item.description: United Airlines said on Monday it had resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights, just days after a malfunction in the US Federal Aviation Administration’s network prompted a nationwide ground stop. Chicago-based United said in a statement that while some flights were delayed because of the issue on Monday afternoon, flights that were in the air and flights on its United Express regional network were not impacted. “There is no indication that this was a cybersecurity-related...

item.title: Top Chinese cancer researcher calls on Hong Kong to deepen research ties with mainland
item.description: A leading Chinese blood cancer specialist has urged Hong Kong to deepen research collaboration with mainland China, saying the city could play a unique role in connecting the mainland’s growing scientific capabilities with the international life sciences community. item.title: UK PM Andy Burnham says Brexit has not worked ahead of a reset summit with the EU
item.description: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Monday that it is time to admit that Brexit has not delivered for the UK and that the country needs a much closer relationship with the European Union to combat growing isolationism around the world. item.title: Why China is betting on ‘home-court diplomacy’ at the Shenzhen Apec gathering
item.description: In October 2001, with the world still reeling from the September 11 attacks and China on the cusp of joining the World Trade Organization, then Chinese president Jiang Zemin opened the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) leaders’ meeting in Shanghai. The world, he said, was at “a crucial moment, a moment of great hope as well as imposing challenges”. item.title: Squeezed in the US, China’s CATL bets on Argentina’s battery storage boom
item.description: China’s CATL, the world’s largest battery maker, has opened a commercial office in Argentina as a base to expand from grid batteries in Buenos Aires into storage for mines, data centres and Patagonian wind farms, Argentine media reported on Monday. Contemporary Amperex Technology Co Ltd (CATL) already supplies the country’s largest storage project and has pitched its systems to 35 companies interested in a government storage tender.
